statements.subject: client
statements.description: Seek-Style is a general-header that MAY be included in any PLAY request to indicate the client's preference for any media stream that has the random access properties.
actions: include Seek-Style header in PLAY request

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server MUST always include the header in any PLAY response for media with random access properties to indicate what policy was applied.
actions: include Seek-Style header in PLAY response indicating applied policy

statements.subject: server
statements.description: A server that receives an unknown Seek-Style policy MUST ignore it and select the server default policy.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: A client receiving an unknown policy MUST ignore it and use the Range header and any media synchronization information as basis to determine what the server did.
actions: use Range header and media synchronization information to determine server action

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the server searched to a random access point, the server MUST return the CoRAP policy in the Seek-Style header and adjust the Range header to reflect the position of the selected RAP.
actions: return CoRAP policy in Seek-Style header
adjust Range header to reflect position of selected RAP

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In case the random access point is farther away and the server chooses to continue from the current pause point, it MUST include the "Next" policy in the Seek-Style header and adjust the Range header start point to the current pause point.
statements.pre_cond: rap.is_farther_away = true & server.continues_from_pause_point = true & request.seek_style = CoRAP
actions: adjust Range header start point to current pause point

statements.subject: participant
statements.description: This policy MUST only be used on the client's explicit request.
actions: apply Next seek-style policy only when client has explicitly requested it
